purpose: Reference metadata and local-import contract for classic World at War Zombies audio. No copyrighted Activision/Treyarch audio bytes are stored in this repository.

references.behavior: Classic Zombies GAME OVER musical sting/guitar sequence; use on Nacht end-game screen.

references.known_waw_context: Initial WAVE_1 / classic round-start presentation; community references commonly identify the WaW round-start evil laugh.
references.behavior: Play once when Round 1 is committed while the first chalk/tally presentation changes from white toward red.
references.note: The exact laugh may be a separate cue inside the original intro/round-start presentation; WAVE_1 and mx_zombie_wave_1 are preserved as verified public modding references without claiming they are the laugh sample itself.

references.behavior: Optional tally/chalk accent for later round transitions.

policy.audio_bytes: must come from a user's lawfully obtained local files or separately licensed replacement sources
policy.noncommercial_note: A community/noncommercial build does not by itself grant redistribution rights to copyrighted game audio.
